landing.title: Order from your table.
landing.subtitle: Scan the QR code on your table to browse the menu, order, follow your food live and pay — no app, no waiting.
landing.scanTitle: Scan the QR at your table
landing.scanBody: Point your phone camera at the code on the table tent. Your table opens instantly.
landing.step1Body: Open your table’s menu in a second.
landing.step2Body: Add dishes, tweak them, send it to your waiter.
landing.step3Body: Watch it cook live, then pay with bKash, Nagad, card or cash.
landing.footer: Made for dine-in guests. No sign-up, no app download.
